_comment: Fabric Loader dependency overrides. See DependencyOverrides in the loader:
rpgsp 1.0.4 declares 'rpgmana': '=1.0.8.2' - an exact pin, which Fabric
enforces literally, so the pack would not launch with rpgmana 1.0.8.4:
'requires version 1.0.8.2 of rpgmana, but only the wrong version is present'.
The pin is an upstream oversight, not a real constraint. rpgsp 1.0.4 was
published 2025-03-20, eight months AFTER rpgmana's final 1.0.8.4 (2024-07-17).
Verified at bytecode level: the only difference between 1.0.8.2 and 1.0.8.4 is
a removed PRIVATE method, ManaComponentMixin.getRegenSpeed. The four classes
rpgsp actually references - Rpgmana, api/ManaInterface, api/SpellcostMixinInterface
and config/ServerConfig - are signature-identical across the two versions.
Downgrading rpgmana instead does NOT work: 1.0.8.2 pins 'archon': '0.6.2'
(also exact), and the pack ships archon 0.8.1, so it just moves the crash one
link down the chain. Relaxing the pin here keeps every mod at its newest build.
